rationale: Add proc README semantics for archived payments, observed/home/store coordinates, and opaque fingerprints; keep distance-only signals soft and avoid treating archived missing baskets as hard mismatches.

dependencies.why: Legitimate 3DS workflow-state transitions used for payment workflow-state invariant checks.
Primary risk record: fingerprints, payment_created_at, payment_status, observed_latitude/longitude, is_archived_basket_reference, 3DS columns.
Customer identity and home_latitude/home_longitude context for distinguishing remote shopping from observed-location fraud.
Joined store location axis for geo anomaly checks.
Basket resource lines (requested_quantity) for quantity/resource reconciliation.
Line-level reconciliation (purchased_quantity, item_unit_price_cents) for amount anomalies.
Catalogue price joins for amount/line checks.
Reserve/availability arithmetic and store/SKU resource axis.
Archived-payment semantics, observed-coordinate meaning, and opaque fingerprint semantics.
Coarse customer home-area coordinate semantics used by risk fixtures.
Store branch coordinate semantics for payment-risk/distance checks.

rollback.strategy: Revert to v0005 if the added semantics over-constrain fraud cohort discovery or conflict with a future risk policy.

retired_reason: post-world-refresh clean competition: prevent resolver fallback to stale historical BP versions while keeping version files in place for future PA-fix history
